name: Zero to Hero
description: When a non-Pokémon ally of Palafin takes damage from a source outside that ally's control, Palafin may enter its Hero Form. In Hero Form, Palafin's size changes to Medium, its AC increases by 4, its base walking speed becomes 30ft, and each of its STR and DEX scores increase by 4, up to a maximum of 22. It may do this once per long rest. It reverts to normal form at the end of combat.
